question: How much do the gold labels depend on the labeller? (Opus 5.5 re-labels the personas Sonnet labelled)
why: Mickey's action item for Yotam (recap). Every accuracy figure on anon-personas is measured against golden profiles one model wrote and no person reviewed; this case asks how much of the figure is the labeller.
source: Mickey's action item for Yotam (recap); Yotam's approval 2026-11-11 (Amendment A3 context)
hypothesis: Sonnet's and Opus's golden profiles agree on at least 85% of slots; disagreement concentrates in text categories and level.

config.first_labeller: claude-sonnet-5-5 on anon-personas; the author on syn1

cost_estimate: about 30 Opus 5.5 calls per run (9 syn1 personas plus the seeded 20 of anon-personas), three runs; no Opus price is in the lab's price table, so usd is not computed

deviations.from: test tree row: none (this case has no row)
deviations.what: Amendment A1 and A2 apply as for every anon-personas case: the persona set is anon-personas, run on the seeded sample of 20 (sample_size 20, sample_seed 20261110, random.Random(seed).sample(sorted(user_ids), 20)), with syn1 beside it as the reference. Labels not human-reviewed: the frozen golden profiles on anon-personas were written by Sonnet and no person has reviewed them (Amendment A2, decision 1). The manifest was set by the lane brief on Yotam's approval of 2026-11-11 (Amendment A3 context), not copied from a test tree row.
deviations.bar: label_agreement mean >= 0.85 on anon-personas only. syn1 (the author's golden against Opus) is the reference and carries no bar; label_agreement per slot and label_both_empty_share are reported with no bar.
deviations.pipeline: Opus is given the same labeling prompt and the same checks the Sonnet labeller used (L/label.py: build_system and label_item, brief anon-personas), on the persona's turns only: golden, timeline, tags and the author's notes are removed before the call. 'Same final value' compares the `golden` slot forms: an enum slot has the same `value` (accept lists ignored); a list slot has the same set of included categories; a free-text slot shares at least one keyword; the timeline and the tags are not compared. The result keeps one letter per slot (agree, differ, frozen-only, opus-only, both-empty), never the Opus labels. The Opus labels are written only under $LA_LAB_DATA_DIR/partial/reverify/label-agreement so that a timed-out slice resumes, and are not committed. An item that gets no valid labels in three attempts is invalid and left out of the ratios.
deviations.cost: The lab's price table has no entry for Claude Opus 5.5, so `cost.usd` reads 0.0 and the token counts are the figure to read.
